background.$description: Dialog alias of the shared modal overlay colour. It separates the active dialog from inert page content without being the only indication that the dialog is open.

radius.$description: Dialog corner radius for inset layouts. Full-screen dialogs use radius.none.

small.$description: Maximum inline size for short confirmations and focused tasks. At a 16px root size, 32rem equals 512px.

medium.$description: Default maximum inline size for forms and standard dialog content. At a 16px root size, 40rem equals 640px.

large.$description: Maximum inline size for complex content that genuinely benefits from more room. At a 16px root size, 56rem equals 896px.

viewportInset.$description: Minimum space between an inset dialog and each viewport edge, including on mobile.

header.$description: Default inset for the dialog header.

content.$description: Default inset for the scrollable dialog content area.

footer.$description: Default inset for the dialog action area.

sectionGap.$description: Gap between dialog header, content and footer regions when they do not have separate boundaries.
